grammar:
root ::= "{" ws "\"cypher\"" ws ":" ws "\"" query "\"" ws "}"

query ::= match_clause (ws match_clause){0,3} (ws where_clause)? ws return_clause (ws order_clause)? ws limit_clause

match_clause ::= "MATCH " pattern
pattern ::= node (rel node){0,4}
node ::= "(" var? label_part scope ")"
label_part ::= ":" label
scope ::= " {" wsp "_workspace_id" wsp ":" wsp "$workspace_id" wsp "}"
rel ::= arrow_l rel_detail arrow_r
arrow_l ::= "-" | "<-"
arrow_r ::= "->" | "-"
rel_detail ::= "[" var ":" reltype hop_bound? "]"
hop_bound ::= "*1.." digit
digit ::= "1" | "2" | "3" | "4"

where_clause ::= "WHERE " predicate (" AND " predicate){0,5}
predicate ::= ref ws comparator ws param
comparator ::= "=" | ">=" | "<=" | ">" | "<" | "<>"
param ::= "$channel_risk" | "$risk_tier" | "$acct_no" | "$amount" | "$limit" | "$ts" | "$a" | "$n"

return_clause ::= "RETURN " ret_item (", " ret_item){0,7}
ret_item ::= (aggregate | ref | "DISTINCT " ref) (" AS " var)?
aggregate ::= agg_fn "(" ("DISTINCT " )? ref ")"
agg_fn ::= "collect" | "count" | "avg" | "max" | "min" | "sum"

order_clause ::= "ORDER BY " ref (" DESC" | " ASC")?
limit_clause ::= "LIMIT $limit"

ref ::= var ("." prop)?
label ::= "Account" | "Channel" | "Company" | "Medium" | "Person" | "Loan"
reltype ::= "USES_CHANNEL" | "GUARANTEE" | "TRANSFER" | "WITHDRAW" | "DEPOSIT" | "SIGN_IN" | "INVEST" | "APPLY" | "REPAY" | "OWN"
prop ::= "_workspace_id" | "channel_risk" | "cross_border" | "risk_weight" | "is_blocked" | "risk_level" | "term_years" | "acct_type" | "principal" | "risk_tier" | "owner_id" | "tx_count" | "acct_no" | "channel" | "country" | "flagged" | "amount" | "sector" | "label" | "limit" | "share" | "code" | "iban" | "name" | "type" | "age" | "id" | "ts"
var ::= [a-z] [a-z0-9_]{0,24}
ws ::= " "?
wsp ::= " "?

samples.cypher:
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[r:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(r) AS transfer_count, sum(r.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[r:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(r) AS transfer_count, sum(r.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})- [r:TRANSFER]-> (b {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(r) AS transfer_count, max(r.amount) AS max_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})- [r:TRANSFER]-> (b {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(r) AS transfer_count, max(r.amount) AS max_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE dst.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (src)-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(ch:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE ch.risk_weight >= $channel_risk
RETURN src.acct_no AS sender_acct_no, src.id AS sender_id
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE dst.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (src)-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(ch:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE ch.risk_weight >= $channel_risk
RETURN src.acct_no AS sender_acct_no, src.id AS sender_id
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
MATCH (src)-[:TRANSFER]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(dest)
RETURN owner.id AS owner_id, owner.name AS owner_name, labels(owner) AS owner_labels
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
MATCH (src)-[:TRANSFER]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(dest)
RETURN owner.id AS owner_id, owner.name AS owner_name, labels(owner) AS owner_labels
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[r:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[t:TRANSFER]->(target2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE target.acct_no = $acct_no RETURN count(r) AS transfer_count, sum(r.amount) AS total_amount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[r:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[t:TRANSFER]->(target2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE target.acct_no = $acct_no RETURN count(r) AS transfer_count, sum(r.amount) AS total_amount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[r:TRANSFER]-(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no RETURN count(r) AS transfer_count, max(r.amount) AS max_amount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[r:TRANSFER]-(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no RETURN count(r) AS transfer_count, max(r.amount) AS max_amount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE dst.acct_no = $acct_no AND t.amount >= $amount AND t.ts >= $ts AND t.channel_risk >= $channel_risk AND t.risk_tier = $risk_tier AND t.name = $n RETURN src.acct_no AS sender_acct_no, src.id AS sender_id LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE dst.acct_no = $acct_no AND t.amount >= $amount AND t.ts >= $ts AND t.channel_risk >= $channel_risk AND t.risk_tier = $risk_tier AND t.name = $n RETURN src.acct_no AS sender_acct_no, src.id AS sender_id LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[t:TRANSFER]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE src.acct_no = $a AND t._workspace_id = $channel_risk AND dest._workspace_id = $risk_tier AND src._workspace_id = $n AND src._workspace_id = $ts AND src._workspace_id = $acct_no RETURN dest.id AS dest_account_id, dest.acct_no AS dest_acct_no, dest.owner_id AS dest_owner_id LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id })-[t:TRANSFER]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE src.acct_no = $a AND t._workspace_id = $channel_risk AND dest._workspace_id = $risk_tier AND src._workspace_id = $n AND src._workspace_id = $ts AND src._workspace_id = $acct_no RETURN dest.id AS dest_account_id, dest.acct_no AS dest_acct_no, dest.owner_id AS dest_owner_id LIMIT $limit
